OSEDTT.Title: Dungeon Turn Tracker
OSEDTT.Label: Label
OSEDTT.DurationHint: A number or a dice formula, e.g. 1d6+6.
OSEDTT.ResetConfirm: Reset all turns, rests and timers? Notes are kept.
OSEDTT.JumpConfirm: Advance {n} turns at once? All checks for those turns will be rolled.

Chat.MustRest: The party must rest for 1 turn (−1 to attack and damage until they do).

Notify.NoAccess: Only the GM can open the turn tracker.

wanderingInterval.name: Wandering monster check every X turns

autoRoll.name: Roll wandering checks automatically
autoRoll.hint: If off, only a reminder is posted.

whisperWandering.name: Whisper wandering checks to GM
whisperWandering.hint: Hide wandering monster rolls from players.

restInterval.name: Rest required every X turns
restInterval.hint: OSE default: 1 turn of rest per 6 turns (1 hour).

syncWorldTime.name: Advance world time
syncWorldTime.hint: Each turn also advances Foundry world time by 10 minutes.
